[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the Wall Township, New Jersey cable landing station, described by NJFX and other press sources as Tata Communications' international cable landing station on the Jersey Shore, where Tata Communications leases carrier neutral meet me room space to NJFX. This registry also separately lists a Tata Communications operator record, tied to a Hillsboro, Oregon facility, which is the same global company; this Wall Township record is linked as a duplicate rather than a distinct entity, consistent with New Jersey press sources identifying it as a Tata Communications facility. Tata Communications is a global telecommunications provider headquartered in Mumbai, India, a subsidiary of the Tata Group, operating one of the world's largest wholly owned subsea cable networks. No published critical IT megawatt figures were found for this landing station, consistent with cable landing stations being network termination facilities rather than general purpose colocation data centers. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
